title: EC 1.2.7: t-SNE of Conjoint triad
caption: t-SNE projection of all 550 proteins in the EC 1.2.7 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.13. Axes have no units, and distances between far-apart clusters are not meaningful. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
